Uses of Package
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.sms

Packages that use com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.sms
Package
Description
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott
One-time token authentication: e-mail and SMS codes and magic links as a primary sign-in method and as a second factor, the per-channel factors, the rate limits, the providers and filters, and the phone management API and account page.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.ott
Use cases of the one-time-code (e-mail and SMS) authentication factor: requesting, verifying and cleaning up codes, and the policy beans they share.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.sms
Use cases of the SMS channel: phone enrolment and verification, cost-capped sending of codes and the enrolment query of the SMS second factor.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.sms
Phones and text messages: the phone number value object, the phone a user verified, the ports to send messages, keep phones and pending verifications, record the spend, and the policy that caps the cost.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.sms
PostgreSQL implementations of the SMS ports: the verified phone numbers and the phone verifications in progress (both over the user_phones table) and the SMS cost ledger (over the sms_cost_ledger table).
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.sms
SMS adapter of the authorization server: the logging default sender with its bounded outbox, the Twilio and Amazon SNS gateways (each enabled by its own profile) and the libphonenumber normaliser.
